claims.rationale: The source makes a reproducing command the precondition for everything else: 'Do not proceed to hypothesise without a loop' (line 55) and 'No red-capable command, no Phase 2' (line 66), where the command must already have been run at least once (line 59). It then requires reproducing and minimising before hypothesising (line 86), 3-5 ranked hypotheses (line 90), one variable per probe (line 102), tagged debug logs (line 110), a regression test before the fix (lines 124-126) and a cleanup checklist (lines 132-138). It explicitly permits unattended progress: show the ranked list to the user but 'Don't block on it; proceed with your ranking if the user is AFK' (line 98). Plausible failure modes: 'Be aggressive. Be creative. Refuse to give up.' (line 22) together with looping a trigger 100 times and adding stress (line 51) sets no bound on load placed on the user's environment; running reproduction commands against a live service can have side effects the text does not address.
